title: Postgres MCP operator verification rollout validation scenarios

scenarios.name: Provider triage
scenarios.description: Readable table output for a grouped provider/status triage loop.

input.sql:
WITH latest_status(route_id, provider, status) AS (
  VALUES
    (101, 'provider_a', 'landed'),
    (102, 'provider_a', 'queued'),
    (103, 'provider_b', 'queued'),
    (104, 'provider_b', 'retry')
)
SELECT provider, status, COUNT(*) AS route_count
FROM latest_status
GROUP BY provider, status
ORDER BY provider, status;

scenarios.name: Direct-route date counts
scenarios.description: Minimal sql-only invocation for a scalar date/count verification loop.

input.sql:
WITH route_dates(route_id, landed_at) AS (
  VALUES
    (201, DATE '2026-03-06'),
    (202, DATE '2026-03-07'),
    (203, DATE '2026-03-07')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS direct_route_count
FROM route_dates
WHERE landed_at >= DATE '2026-03-07';

scenarios.name: Queue-state verification
scenarios.description: Compact fast_agent polling loop for recent queue rows.

input.sql:
WITH recrawl_queue(route, status, last_seen_at) AS (
  VALUES
    ('/offers/101', 'queued', TIMESTAMP '2026-03-09 09:15:00'),
    ('/offers/102', 'retry', TIMESTAMP '2026-03-09 09:10:00'),
    ('/offers/103', 'queued', TIMESTAMP '2026-03-09 09:05:00')
)
SELECT route, status, last_seen_at
FROM recrawl_queue
ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC;

scenarios.name: Landed-date diffing
scenarios.description: Readable row output for before/after landed-date comparisons.

input.sql:
WITH before_snapshot(route_id, landed_at) AS (
  VALUES
    (301, DATE '2026-03-04'),
    (302, DATE '2026-03-06')
),
after_snapshot(route_id, landed_at) AS (
  VALUES
    (301, DATE '2026-03-05'),
    (302, DATE '2026-03-06')
)
SELECT after_snapshot.route_id,
       before_snapshot.landed_at AS previous_landed_at,
       after_snapshot.landed_at AS current_landed_at,
       (after_snapshot.landed_at - before_snapshot.landed_at) AS delta_days
FROM after_snapshot
JOIN before_snapshot USING (route_id)
ORDER BY after_snapshot.route_id;
